Hand-curated variable-control metadata for the procs whose contribution is not a single always-on literal: self-stacking buffs, which need a stack cap, and "By the Slotted Power" magnitudes, which resolve through an archetype modifier table.

This is an ADDITIVE overlay and the LAST of the eight merges `emit-contract.cjs` performs to build the contract's `proc-data` section. Unlike `proc-residual-effects.json`, which replaces a proc's whole `effects` array, each entry here patches a few fields onto the effects the earlier merges already stitched on, and only onto the effects whose `category` matches — which is what guards a multi-effect entry. That keeps the derived `value`, `duration` and `category` live and regen-safe, and layers on only what the generator cannot derive.

The three patchable fields:
- `maxStacks` — a self-stacking buff's cap, which the generator cannot read because it lives in the proc's prose `mechanics` ("stacks 3 times").
- `scaleTable` — marks a "By the Slotted Power" effect. The derived `value` is `scale × 100`, a raw scale and NOT a percent; the real per-stack magnitude is `value × getTableValue(archetype, scaleTable, level)`. Might of the Tanker: 50 (0.5 × 100) × 0.10 (the Tanker Melee_Res_Dmg value, flat by level) = 5% per stack.
- `valueMax` — the cap on an HP-scaling floor (Reactive Defenses 3% → 12.9%).

Keys match `proc-data.json` keys exactly, and are sorted: there are three of them and no grouping to lose.

_notes.Chance for +RES(ALL): Might of the Tanker (Tanker ATO) — "Chance for +5% Resistance(All) … By the Slotted Power, stacks 3 times". Derived value 50 = scale 0.5 × 100; resolved via Melee_Res_Dmg (Tanker 0.10) ⇒ 5% Res(All) per stack, up to 3 (= 15%).
_notes.Scaling +Res(All): Reactive Defenses "Scaling +Res(All)" — an HP-scaling floor and cap. The floor (value 3) is set in the derived globals table with `scaling: true`; this adds the 12.9% cap.
_notes.Superior Might of the Tanker: Recharge/C: Superior Might of the Tanker — same mechanic, derived value 67 = scale 0.67.
